text: Based on the evidence provided, approximately 2.23% of the property was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. This corresponds to an area of about 81.3 hectares. The loss occurred within a planted forest context, primarily affecting planted forest areas (68.1 hectares), with a smaller portion (13.2 hectares) outside mapped forest areas. The tree-cover loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated using additional data sources.
